main_measure.name: mean unusual 7-bar move of short cases (short direction)
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; mean < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of 7-bar excess return on forecast (grid bars, forecast < 0), t

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 and the slope is positive with t >= 2.
reading: The choppy profile is the 'unknown' regime column; a case is the first short bet in each 7-bar grid cell of a window, drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 7-bar return over all windows, the clustered t uses a G/(G-1) correction, and the slope's t is the ordinary pooled OLS t.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.00688 on the check folds against +0.01126 on every fold
